_about: Football temperaments (Temperament.gd). Every player holds one or two. start_weight: where a temperament's odds start before the record tilts them (1.0 when not listed); leader_from: the Leadership rating from which the record leans to leader. Levers are multipliers other systems read through Temperament.scale(p, lever): over 1 he feels it more, under 1 less. 'decay' over 1 means his opinion marks fade faster; 'faction' over 1 means he is quicker to stand with unhappy teammates (Factions.gd). Grounded in on-field and locker-room personality only.

leader.label: Leader
leader.describe: A voice in the rooms. Rates a coach who backs his players, and the group takes its lead from how you treat him.
leader.ambition: Wants a say in how the club is run and a spot in the leadership group.

clubman.label: Clubman
clubman.describe: Lives for the jumper. Being backed means a lot to him, and he takes a broken promise personally and is slow to let it go.
clubman.ambition: Wants to finish his career at the club.

competitor.label: Competitor
competitor.describe: Hates losing, hates sitting out even more. A drop hits him hard and being backed fires him up.
competitor.ambition: Wants to play finals and win a flag.

professional.label: Professional
professional.describe: Turns up, does the work and takes a hard call in his stride. Expects you to do what you said you would.
professional.ambition: Wants a settled role and a coach he can trust.

quiet_achiever.label: Quiet achiever
quiet_achiever.describe: Goes about his footy without any fuss. Rarely rattled by a drop, quietly grateful for a pat on the back.
quiet_achiever.ambition: Wants to hold his spot in the side.

fiery.label: Fiery
fiery.describe: Wears his heart on his sleeve. Bristles at a hard line from the coach and remembers a slight for a long time.
fiery.ambition: Wants to be the one the side looks to when the game is on the line.

mercurial.label: Mercurial
mercurial.describe: Up and down, on the field and off it. Everything you do lands harder with him, but he moves on quickly.
mercurial.ambition: Wants freedom to play his own game.

mercenary.label: Mercenary
mercenary.describe: Plays for the next contract. A drop or a broken promise stings him less, and loyalty buys you less too.
mercenary.ambition: Wants the best deal on offer, wherever it is.
